about.title: From creative production to digital products.
paragraphs: DreamLab was founded on September 13, 2017, by Nikola and Aleksandra with a simple goal: create work that delivers measurable results, not just beautiful visuals.
What started as a creative studio specializing in marketing, video production, and digital content has grown into a multidisciplinary company serving more than 500 clients worldwide.
Over the years, we've produced more than 10,000 videos, creative concepts, and marketing campaigns across a wide range of industries.
Our portfolio includes animated explainers, documentaries, branded content, commercial productions, and large-scale digital campaigns.

Through agency partnerships, our work has contributed to projects involving globally recognized organizations such as NASA and Michelin, as well as a campaign for a U.S. presidential candidate during a recent election cycle.
Today, DreamLab is entering its next chapter.
Alongside our creative services, we're building software products that solve real-world problems.
Products like Pozari.mk and CaptionLab.mk represent the evolution of years of creative experience into focused digital tools used by real people.

meta.title: Konobar — NFC Digital Waiter | DreamLab
meta.description: A browser-based NFC hospitality system for faster table service.

hero.title:
Fewer waits.
Better
service.
hero.description: A browser-based hospitality system that lets guests request restaurant service directly from their table with a simple NFC tap—without installing an app, creating an account, or trying to attract a waiter’s attention.

overview.title: Bring ease back to hospitality service.
overview.copy: Guests should not need to wave, wait, or leave the table simply to request basic service.

benefits.noInstallText: Guests simply tap the NFC tag already placed on the table.
benefits.instantCommunicationText: Every request is delivered immediately to the service staff.
benefits.fasterResponseText: Waiters always know exactly which table needs attention.

why.title: Ease is built through the service experience, not only the food.
why.copy: A few unnoticed minutes can define how guests remember an entire visit. When requests are visible, structured, and linked to the correct table, staff can respond with more clarity and less friction.

idea.title: Instead of forcing guests to search for staff, give every table a direct digital connection.
idea.description: Each table receives a unique NFC tag. Guests tap the tag, choose a request, and send it directly to the service team.

steps.title:
A simple system,
working together.
steps.copy1: The guest taps the NFC tag placed on the table.
steps.copy2: The mobile interface shows clear service actions.
steps.copy3: The request appears in the service dashboard instantly.
